Dawn Gillman highlights fraud investigations and taxpayer concerns in recent tweets
Minnesota State Representative Dawn Gillman posted a series of tweets on June 23 and 24, 2026, addressing concerns about fraud investigations in Minnesota and expressing gratitude for community efforts.
On June 23, Gillman commented on national attention to alleged fraudulent activities in the state by posting, "So glad folks nationally have been looking into the fraudsters in Minnesota. Once again in @GovTimWalz own backyard," Later that evening, she praised another public official’s efforts to address government spending issues: "Way to shine a big spotlight on the waste of hard earned tax payers dollars @Jonkoznick."
The following day, Gillman shared appreciation for her supporters and colleagues: "Blessed beyond measure. Thanks to all the folks that make this happen. Let’s Go!!!"
Gillman, a Republican elected to represent Minnesota's 17A House District in 2023 after succeeding Tim Miller, has used her platform to highlight fiscal responsibility and community involvement as key priorities during her tenure.
